sn19.1:1.2: ekam samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe || || 2
sn19.1:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca Lakkhaṇo āyasmā ca Mahā-Moggallāno Gijjhakūṭe pabbate viharanti || || 3
sn19.1:1.4: Atha kho āyasmā Mahā-Moggallāno pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yenāyasmā Lakkhaṇo tenupasaṅkami || || 4 Upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Lakkhaṇam etad avoca || ||
sn19.1:1.6: Evam āvuso ti kho āyasmā Lakkhaṇo āyasmato MahāMoggallānassa paccassosi || 5
sn19.1:1.7: Atha kho Āyasmā Mahā-Moggallāno Gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto aññatarasmiṃ padese sitaṃ pātvākāsi || || 6
sn19.1:1.8: Atha kho āyasmā Lakkhaṇo āyasmantaṃ MahāMoggallānam etad avoca || ||
sn19.1:1.9: Ko nu kho āvuso Moggalāna hetu ko paccayo sitassa pātukammāyāti || ||
sn19.1:1.10: Akālo kho āvuso Lakkhaṇa etassa pañhassa ||
sn19.1:1.11: Bhagavato maṃ santike etam pañham pucchāti || || 7
sn19.1:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā ca Lakkhaṇo āyasmā ca MahāMoggalāno Rājagahe piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattam piṇḍapātapatikkantā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || 8 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Lakkhaṇo āyasmantam Mahā-Moggalānam etad avoca || ||
sn19.1:2.2: Idhāyasmā Mahā-Moggalāno Gijjhakūtā pabbatā orohanto aññatarasmim padese sitaṃ pātvākāsi || ||
sn19.1:2.3: Ko nu kho āvuso Moggalāna hetu ko paccayo sitassa pātukammāyāti || || 9
sn19.1:3.1: Idhāham āvuso Gijjhakuṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ aṭṭhikasaṅkhalikaṃ vehāsaṃ gacchantaṃ ||
sn19.1:3.2: tam enaṃ gijjhāpi kākā pi kulalā pi anupatitvā anupatitvā phāsuḷantarikāhi vitacchenti vibhajenti
sn19.1:3.5: Acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho ||
sn19.1:4.3: ñāṇabhūtā vata bhikkhave sāvakā viharanti || yatra hi nāma sāvako evarūpaṃ ñassati vā dakkhati vā sakkhiṃ vā karissati || || 12
sn19.1:4.4: Pubbe pi me so bhikkhave satto diṭṭho ahosi || apicāham na vyākāsiṃ || ||
sn19.1:4.5: Ahañcetaṃ vyākareyyam pare ca me na saddaheyyuṃ ||
sn19.1:4.6: ye me na saddaheyyuṃ || tesaṃ tam assa dīgharattam ahitāya dukkhāya || || 13
sn19.1:4.7: Eso bhikkhave satto imasmiññeva Rājagahe goghāṭako ahosi ||
sn19.1:4.8: so tassa kammassa vipākena bahūni vassāni bahūni vassasatāni bahūni vassasahassāni bahūni vassasatasahassāni niraye pacitvā tasseva kammassa vipākāvasesena evarūpam attabhāvapaṭilābhaṃ paṭisaṃvediyatīti || || Pathamaṃ || ||
